theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity (CIBR) is the only top-ranked theme combining a clean trend_trend hurst_tag (ranked 3), the highest durability_bar of the leaders (0.76), and the broadest breadth (0.90). That high trend-health + breadth profile is exactly what the validated absolute-trend gate rewards: staying power and shallower drawdowns. Its crowding_z is elevated (1.82, crowded=true), which per guardrails is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding at 1.82 is the highest of any scorable theme; if AI-security attention unwinds, the crowded cohort could mean-revert harder than the less-crowded leaders, and the theme has no distinct catalyst beyond the broad AI complex.

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: AI Semiconductors sits just below the leaders (rank 5) but has the single best durability/trend-health combination in the read: durability_bar 0.85, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 0.917, and it is not crowded (z 0.69). This is the cleanest trend-staying-power profile in the table — the one leg here with real historical risk-control value. Rank is mid, so this is a discipline-based lean not a momentum chase.

theses.subject: Regional Banks
theses.thesis: Regional Banks (rank 33, score -0.487) is technically eligible=true but shows breadth 0.0 with hurst 'trend' — a hollow trend with no participation. The absolute-trend gate permitting eligibility while breadth is zero indicates the gate is firing on price alone; the trend-discipline leg argues against paying attention to a zero-breadth theme regardless of eligibility.
evidence: hurst_tag 'trend' with no breadth = hollow trend
theses.dissent: Precisely because everyone ignores it, a reflexive squeeze is possible; it is not crowded (z -0.57) and the trend tag means price is still holding, so an avoid lean could miss a grinding continuation.
